name: PT Indal Aluminium Industry Tbk
summary: PT Indal Aluminium Industry Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of aluminum products in Indonesia. The company operates in four divisions: Manufacturing Industry, Construction Services, Software Services, and General Trading and Investments. It provides aluminum solar frames and mounting systems; architectural products, such as curtain walls, doors, windows, and composite panels; electronic and precision parts, including heat sinks and precision parts; and ladder products comprising household, tradesmen, and heavy-duty industrial ladders, as well as level arcs and planks.
